lines.text: Jeff Bezos takes $81,840 a year from Amazon.
Amazon spends $1.6M on his security alone. So why is his pay so small?
Amazon's boss, Andy Jassy, gets a base salary of $365,000. Bezos's pay hasn't changed in decades.
So where's his real money? He owns about 8% of Amazon.
In April, that slice was worth about $225B.
Earning that on his salary would take 2.7M years.
So Amazon spends 19.6× his salary just to guard him. Paycheck or shares: which would you take?
